question.:question/problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/generate/scratch/17592186166867/plots/8e6824edac6f32f918811ab0a2e19ebf3d2798b6e8f3c35e8feb231b475e54ee.png)

The parabola shown above has equation

$$
{y}^{2}=49x.
$$

Find $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}$ for the right-opening parabola shown above.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The equation of our parabola is 

$$
{y}^{2}=49x.
$$

Finally, to calculate $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x},$ we use implicit differentiation:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({y}^{2}) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(49x) \\ 2y\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =49 \\ \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{49}{2y}\end{aligned}
$$
